parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The name of the device whose upgrade you want to cancel.

Device names must be unique.

You can specify up to 200 device names.

parameters.name: FirmwareId
parameters.description:
The ID of the over-the-air update package, which is the unique identity of the OTA upgrade package.

The firmware ID is one of the parameters returned when you invoke [CreateOTAFirmware](~~147311~~) to create an OTA upgrade package.

You can invoke [ListOTAFirmware](~~147450~~) to view the firmware ID from the response.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If <props="intl"><ph>the **Overview** page or </ph></props>this parameter is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description:
The ID of the upgrade batch. If you specify this parameter, only the device upgrade jobs in the specified batch are canceled.
The batch ID is the **JobId** returned after you call [CreateOTAVerifyJob](~~147480~~), [CreateOTAStaticUpgradeJob](~~147496~~), or [CreateOTADynamicUpgradeJob](~~147887~~) to create an upgrade job. You can also view the batch ID on the **Firmware Details** page of the firmware in the IoT Platform console.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The ProductKey of the product to which the device whose upgrade you want to cancel belongs.
